title: Google Pixel 8 Pro - Unlocked Android Smartphone - 128 GB - Obsidian - 6.7 inch LTPO OLED, Triple Rear Camera, Tensor G3
bullets: Google Tensor G3 delivers on-device AI for Magic Eraser, Call Screen, and Live Translate without sending your data to the cloud.
6.7" LTPO OLED display at up to 120 Hz with Corning Gorilla Glass Victus 2 for smooth scrolling and outdoor brightness.
Triple rear camera system: 50 MP wide, 48 MP ultrawide (macro), and 48 MP telephoto with 5x optical zoom.
Unlocked for all major US carriers — activate on Verizon, T-Mobile, AT&T, or MVNOs with a compatible nano-SIM or eSIM.
Seven years of OS and security updates from Google so the phone stays current longer than typical Android devices.
IP68 water and dust resistance plus wireless charging and reverse wireless charging for earbuds on the go.
What's in the box: Pixel 8 Pro, 1 m USB-C cable, SIM tool, and quick-start guide (charger sold separately).
description: Pixel 8 Pro is Google's flagship unlocked smartphone built around the Tensor G3 chip and a pro-grade camera system. The 6.7-inch LTPO OLED panel adapts refresh rate from 1–120 Hz to balance smoothness and battery life.

Computational photography features like Best Take, Audio Magic Eraser, and Night Sight produce usable shots in low light without a dedicated photography degree. Video Boost (when enabled) uploads overnight for cinematic processing.
As an unlocked device it works with major US carriers. eSIM support lets you switch lines without swapping plastic SIMs — useful for travel or dual-number setups.

aplus.heading: From the manufacturer
paragraphs: Google designs Pixel hardware and software together so features like Call Screen and Photo Unblur feel native rather than bolted on.
Pixel phones receive feature drops several times a year in addition to monthly security patches.

reviews.author: Alex R.
reviews.title: Best camera phone I have owned
reviews.body: Night Sight and the telephoto zoom are excellent. Battery easily lasts a full workday with 5G on. Unlocked activation on T-Mobile took under ten minutes.

reviews.author: Priya K.
reviews.title: Great phone, warm under load
reviews.body: Display and speakers are first-class. It can get warm during 4K video, but nothing alarming. Happy I skipped carrier bloatware by buying unlocked.

reviews.author: Sam T.
reviews.title: Call Screen alone is worth it
reviews.body: Spam calls dropped dramatically. Magic Editor cleaned up vacation photos better than I expected for an on-device tool.

reviews.author: Jordan M.
reviews.title: Solid but expensive accessories
reviews.body: Phone is excellent. Official cases and the Pixel Stand add up quickly. Third-party Qi chargers work fine for daily use.

qa.question: Does this include a wall charger?
qa.answer: No. Google includes a USB-C cable only. Use any USB-PD charger 30W or higher for fast charging.

qa.question: Will it work on Verizon?
qa.answer: Yes. Pixel 8 Pro is unlocked and certified for Verizon, AT&T, and T-Mobile in the US.

qa.question: Is the 128 GB model enough?
qa.answer: For most users yes, especially with Photos backup. Heavy 4K shooters may prefer 256 GB.
